title: Linear / element robustness qualification contract
policy: This contract defines evidence to collect; it does not close G04 or promote any capability.

scope.included_material_class: linear elastic materials declared by each element route

requirements.title: Linear static route and element dispatch
acceptance: declared element and material are accepted
unsupported combinations are rejected
route is deterministic

requirements.title: Element patch and constant-strain behaviour
acceptance: patch or constant-strain test is supplied where mathematically applicable
rigid-body energy is recorded where applicable

requirements.title: Static load diversity and equilibrium
acceptance: supported nodal and distributed loads are exercised only on compatible elements
reaction resultant and moment balance are reported
free residual is reported

requirements.title: Material route and orientation boundaries
acceptance: isotropic elastic routes are covered per element
orientation is tested only where the selected formulation supports it
laminate and orthotropic extensions remain explicitly separate or deferred

requirements.title: Mesh refinement, quality and distortion
acceptance: continuum families include compatible coarse/medium/fine meshes
quality metrics and distortion parameters are recorded
no threshold is treated as approved without Owner review

requirements.title: Invalid inputs and failure modes
acceptance: inverted or degenerate meshes reject safely
invalid material and boundary data reject safely
expected failures are distinguished from solver failures

requirements.title: External correlation where formulation-compatible
acceptance: external tool and version are pinned
same geometry, material, loads and boundary conditions are demonstrated
unavailable external tools are SKIPPED_EXTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE and never PASS

requirements.title: Evidence provenance and anti-forgetting
acceptance: source SHA, clean state, environment, case IDs and artifact digests are recorded
every G04 claim maps to a registry capability and requirement
no other gate is silently closed

minimum_targets.counting_rule: Minimums are unique physical cases; reused G05/G06 cases are not counted twice for a gate closeout.

owner_approved_bounded.definition: r_free is the free-DOF part of K u - f after the declared constraint reduction.
owner_approved_bounded.quasi_zero_load: When ||f_free||_2 < 1.0 in the declared model units, report ||r_free||_2 as an absolute diagnostic; the PASS bound remains 1e-8 in those units. A zero-load rigid-body case is accepted only through its explicit invariant or expected-failure contract, not by claiming a meaningful relative error.
owner_approved_bounded.justification: This is the existing linear audit definition and PASS/WARNING boundary in src/solveur/core/audit.py and src/solveur/core/audit_checks.py; existing static tests observe residuals below this bound.
owner_approved_bounded.limitations: The unit floor is intentionally retained for compatibility with the current audit schema; every case must record units and the absolute numerator.

owner_approved_bounded.definition: Compare the external resultant F_ext with the support reaction resultant R using ||F_ext + R||_2; report the analogous moment imbalance about the declared origin separately.
owner_approved_bounded.quasi_zero_resultant: If both compared resultants are below the unit floor, the metric is interpreted as the absolute imbalance in declared model units and must still be <= 1e-10 for PASS. A self-equilibrated load with near-zero net resultant is not certified by this metric alone; free residual, moment balance and the load-vector audit remain mandatory.
owner_approved_bounded.justification: These are the existing force_balance_relative_error and moment_balance_relative_error definitions and PASS/WARNING boundaries in src/solveur/core/audit.py and src/solveur/core/audit_checks.py; distributed-load and solver tests exercise the same resultants.
owner_approved_bounded.limitations: This is a global resultant check, not a substitute for local equilibrium or free-DOF residual evidence; the origin and model units must be recorded.

owner_approved_bounded.observable: A predeclared scalar or vector response q at the same physical location/DOF or the same declared norm; stress/strain peaks at singularities are not eligible as the sole observable.
owner_approved_bounded.reference: q_ref is declared before execution and is an analytical reference, a dimensional scale from the same case, or another explicitly justified nonzero response scale. If all scales are zero, use an absolute analytical/invariant check instead and do not claim mesh convergence from this policy.
non_monotone_conditions: poor/distorted quality outside the declared quality bound
changed topology, load transfer or boundary discretization
mixed element order or non-compatible meshes
owner_approved_bounded.justification: The 1% bound follows the existing Owner-approved bounded refinement convention in G05, while the three-level requirement and observable restrictions prevent a universal or artificial convergence claim.
owner_approved_bounded.limitations: This policy establishes bounded stabilization of a declared response only; it does not require monotone convergence and does not qualify all fields or all mesh qualities.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: All eight registered element routes use explicit dispatch/material/load/BC declarations.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Required to prevent unsupported combinations from being silently qualified.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Patch/constant-strain or rigid-body invariant is required only where mathematically applicable to the family.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Covers element kinematics without forcing a continuum patch oracle onto BEAM2 or DISCRETE.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Load types are restricted by the element route and reaction/moment/residual fields are recorded.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Exercises both nodal and compatible distributed loading with global and free-DOF checks.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Isotropic routes are base scope; orientation/laminate extensions remain formulation-specific and deferred.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Preserves maturity boundaries while testing declared material matrices.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Continuum families receive compatible refinement/quality evidence; BEAM2 and DISCRETE are not forced into continuum mesh claims.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Three-level bounded response study plus quality/distortion reporting is proportionate to the gate.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Invalid mesh, material and boundary inputs are checked through deterministic expected-failure contracts.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Separates safe rejection from an unexpected solver failure.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: External comparison is attempted only for genuinely comparable formulations and load conventions.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Requires pinned provenance and prevents non-comparable tools from becoming false PASS evidence.

requirements_reviewed.family_adaptation: Every claim remains linked to a registry capability, case ID, source SHA and artifact manifest.
requirements_reviewed.sufficiency: Prevents silent maturity promotion or cross-gate evidence reuse.

conditions: The normalized observable and reference are declared before execution.
The tolerance is justified by element order, conditioning, mesh and oracle precision.
A case-specific value may be stricter or looser than another case; no universal value is inferred from existing PASS results.

owner_review.external_correlation: Code_Aster or CalculiX may provide evidence only when geometry, material, formulation, loads, BCs and output convention are comparable; otherwise record SKIPPED_EXTERNAL_UNAVAILABLE or NOT_COMPARABLE, never PASS.
owner_review.gate_decision: This review approves bounded contract policies only; it does not execute or close G04.
